variants.display_name: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 · vLLM batch 4 + BF16 · Region window 64
variants.change_description: From BF16 control: submit up to 64 regions before waiting; server batch limit stays four per GPU.

outcome_note.summary: Region window 64 reduced p50 from 4.17 to 3.79 s (1.10×); all 30 calls passed.
outcome_note.next: Fresh profiling found queued work at the four-request server limit. First combine the separately successful dynamic-page change, then test server concurrency eight.

variants.display_name: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 · vLLM batch 4 + BF16 · Dynamic pages
variants.change_description: From BF16 control: send the next PDF page to whichever layout worker becomes free.

outcome_note.summary: Dynamic pages reduced p95 from 28.31 to 26.68 s; throughput rose to 24.06 pages/min. All 30 calls passed.
outcome_note.next: The Census profile identified a late page-5 region. Combine dynamic pages with window 64, which separately improved p50.
